versions.message: Vocabulary update: re-resolved against OMOP vocabulary v5.0 29-AUG-26 (previously v5.0 27-FEB-26). 9663 -> 9657 concepts. Removed 6 concepts deprecated in the new release, whose replacement is already in the set: dexamethasone / tramazoline Nasal Spray [Dexa-Rhinospray] (1830975); dexamethasone 0.02 MG/ACTUAT / tramazoline 0.12 MG/ACTUAT [Dexa-Rhinospray] (1830976); dexamethasone 0.02 MG/ACTUAT / tramazoline 0.12 MG/ACTUAT Nasal Spray [Dexa-Rhinospray] (1830977); 125 ACTUAT dexamethasone 0.02 MG/ACTUAT / tramazoline 0.12 MG/ACTUAT Nasal Spray [Dexa-Rhinospray] (1832743); dexamethasone 1 MG/ML / tobramycin 3 MG/ML [TOBACIN-D] (2012201); and 1 more.
